objective: Implement a deterministic point-in-time Trend Family that emits one governed family-level TechnicalEvidence object from correlated price-path trend transforms without creating independent duplicate votes or trade authority.
scope: Define a governed Trend Family policy
Validate a single-symbol single-timeframe trusted OHLCV trend window with consistent dataset and quality lineage
Compute deterministic slow-baseline slope and current price distance
Classify bullish, bearish or neutral trend state using explicit symmetric thresholds
Emit exactly one TREND family-level TechnicalEvidence object with a single independence group
Bound strength and confidence as deterministic evidence scores rather than empirical probabilities
Reconcile P08-B task and lock state across GitHub and Linear
out_of_scope: Signal fusion, probability calibration, risk approval or execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: active task none and active lock none before P08-B activation
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P08 source
Monotonic rising price path produces bullish family evidence
Monotonic falling price path produces bearish family evidence
Flat or threshold-ambiguous path produces neutral family evidence
Trend metrics and evidence identity are deterministic
Correlated trend transforms emit one shared independence group and count as one confirmation
Strength/confidence remain bounded and are not represented as trade probability
P08-B evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No execution adapter or broker/exchange/order authority is imported
No network or credential access is required
rollback: Revert P08-B trend module, policy, tests, evidence/CI wiring and P08-B active-state reconciliation. P08-A remains canonical and no trading state changes.
definition_of_done: Trend Family implemented with one family-level evidence output
Correlated price-path transforms do not create duplicate independent votes
Point-in-time and lineage invariants fail closed
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
